entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I... I need to make a return. I ordered something a while back and it's just not right. I've been a loyal customer for years and I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To start, could you tell me a bit more? What specifically is the issue with the item?

It's the Pro-Cycle jersey. I saved up for it, and... it's just the wrong size. It's way too tight across the shoulders, I can barely move in it. It's just been sitting in my closet, a sad reminder. I really needed this money back if it didn't work out.
I understand completely. It's so frustrating when a fit isn't what you expected. Do you have your order number handy so I can pull up the details?
Yes, let me see... it's VF-8675309.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Cycle jersey. It looks like it was delivered 39 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I've just been so busy... I was worried I waited too long. Please tell me I can still return it.

No worries at all. For a standard item like that jersey, our return policy is 90 days from the delivery date. You are well within that window. We can absolutely process this for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful news! You've just made my day. I think for now I'd just like the refund, if that's okay. Thank you so much, Sarah.

Of course. I'm happy I could help. I've just initiated the return process and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the jersey back up, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
Perfect. Thank you again for being so helpful.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
